facts.fact: Gastown has brick buildings, cobblestone streets and the Steam Clock; the neighbourhood was designated a National Historic Site of Canada in 2009.
facts.location: Discover where hip meets history section.

facts.fact: The Steam Clock was built in 1977, rather than dating from the nineteenth-century origins of the neighbourhood.
facts.location: The Gastown clock, built in 1977, is one of only a few steam clocks in the world.
